The System

Two Halves · One Click

Slide together.
Auto-lock.

The Rotating/Quick Release is a two-part quick connect. One half stays on your rig; the other rides on your gear. Bring them together and a spring-loaded catch binds them tight. To release, press the catch and pull free — one hand, no tools.

Half 01

Rotating/Quick Release Receiver

The fixed half. Mounts to your belt, vest, plate carrier, pack, or MOLLE/PALS webbing and stays put. The auto-locking jaw accepts the disk and holds it under load.

Lives on your rig
Half 02

Rotating/Quick Release 360° Disk

The carried half — built into every Atlas 46 pouch. Drop it into the receiver to lock; lift the catch to drop the pouch off the rig in a second. Re-clock the cant any time.

Lives on your gear

Index Your Cant

24 positions.
15° apart.

Rotate the disk in the receiver to any of 24 detents around a full 360°. Each click is 15° — dial in the exact angle for a draw, a reach, or a seated cab, then lock it. No screws, no posts, no tools.

Tool-Free Engagement

Slide in.
Quarter turn.

Built To Last

Why It Holds Up

Duty-strong,
by design.

Auto-Locking Mount

Positive spring engagement the moment the disk seats. It won't walk loose under vibration, impact, or a full day of motion. Release is deliberate — never accidental.

24 Cant Positions

A full 360° of adjustment in 15° steps. Re-index by hand in seconds — no tools, no hardware to loosen and re-torque.

USA-Made Polymer

Molded in the USA from a high-strength glass-filled polymer. It shrugs off shop floors, jobsites, and years of daily use.

Mounts Anywhere

The receiver fits belts, vests, plate carriers, bags, packs, and MOLLE/PALS webbing — one system across your whole loadout.
